Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for taking the time to demo with us today — really appreciated the context on your ingestion pipeline and the scale you expect for search and chat. Per our conversation, I pulled together: 1) a short pricing deck with recommended configurations, and 2) a line-item estimate based on the usage profile you shared. Both are attached.

Key recap: 
- Recommended deployment: Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU) for predictable latency at your 99th percentile SLAs
- Suggested model family: opt-13b quantized variant for cost/latency balance
- Pilot scope: 2-week POC covering search and a gated chat flow (estimate attached)

Attachments: pricing-deck-acme-20260810.pdf, acme-estimate-20260810.xlsx

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick 20-min walkthrough of the deck and estimate (I can do Wed/Thu morning PDT)
2) Confirm priority/timing (are you targeting an internal decision this quarter?)

If helpful I can also loop in our pricing lead, Marissa, to go over contract/commit options and any potential discounts for a reserved pilot.

Let me know a time that works and I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
